name: 01_energy_price_fast_retrain

dataset.display_name: Polish Day-Ahead Electricity Market, Demand, Renewables and Weather
dataset.split: quota stratified by target distribution plus high-variance feature quantile bins

business_question: Which program gives the best P90 day-ahead price forecast that can be retrained within the window before gate closure?

seeds.source: step-60000 neural policy (Rust/Candle CPU), produced by agy_resource_fitness; see seeds.provenance.json

calibration.rules: limits = median calibration reading (2 s.f.); composite resource scale = median reading, accuracy scale = train target sigma; prices = share x median error / median reading

why: Day-ahead bids are due before gate closure, and the model is refitted on the latest prices every day. Under-forecasting a price spike is the expensive mistake, hence P90 pinball. A program that is accurate but cannot be retrained inside the window is useless, hence a hard limit on fit_seconds rather than a soft price.
caveats: Time-ordered data, but jope pipeline run validates on an unordered fold partition of train.csv, so this case does not exercise chronological (regime) validation
fit_seconds is a reading of this host under its load; the limit is calibrated on this host and must be recalibrated elsewhere
